name: VA-03
label: Safe D

key_factors: Bobby Scott is a long-tenured incumbent in a D+18 district
Republican Edwin Rivera has raised only about $6,600
Prediction markets price Scott's win at 96%
No polls or expert ratings, but fundamentals are lopsided
model.rationale: The district's D+18 lean, Scott's incumbency, and a massive fundraising gap leave no credible path for Rivera, and markets agree at 96% for Scott. The forecast stays essentially at the fundamentals-driven baseline.
model.watch: A major outside-spending surge for Rivera or a polling shock would be needed to move this race at all.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Bobby Scott has held this southeastern Virginia seat for decades, and the district's D+18 partisan lean makes it one of the safest Democratic seats in the state. He enters the general election with a large financial edge, having raised roughly $688,000 to Republican Edwin Rivera's about $6,600, and he carries the advantage of incumbency in a favorable environment.

Rivera faces steep structural odds with minimal resources and no outside support on record. Independent candidates Makiba Gaines and Stephen Woll have little funding and are unlikely to affect the outcome. Prediction markets price Scott's chances at 96%, consistent with the fundamentals. No polls or expert ratings cover the race, so the forecast rests on district lean, money, and incumbency, all of which point the same direction.
